relations: The man stands facing the mirror wall with hands on hips, so any initiated movement shifts his reflected silhouette accordingly.
The group visible in the mirror reflection tracks the foreground man's pose, updating their apparent positions as he moves.
The wooden floor and barre remain static, providing a fixed reference frame for any dance motion the man begins.
If the man turns or steps, his reflection and the mirrored group adjust their orientation relative to the mirror plane.
